objectives.text: Identify where autoboxing and unboxing happen when primitive values go into and come out of a collection
Predict the result of comparing two Integer objects with == and with equals, and of unboxing a null Integer

minutes.basis: intake planning estimate under the new-course rule in docs/tools/validators.md (budget at least ceil(max(estimator P50, modeledWorstPath)), 15-minute ceiling, no day-pool shares). See evidence/collections-streams/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
